sentences.en: He took his daughter with him whenever he went abroad.
sentences.zh: 无论他去国外哪里，都会带上他的女儿。

sentences.en: Can you find the time to play with our daughter?
sentences.zh: 你能抽时间陪我们的女儿玩吗？

sentences.en: Our daughter will be in the Shichi-Go-San festival this year.
sentences.zh: 今年我们女儿会参加七五三节。
